title: Clair Obscure & Wither Reincarnated
description: This texture pack does not add new content. It replaces the original Wither battle music with music from Clair Obscure.
body:
If you’re a fan of Clair Obscure, this pack is highly recommended. It greatly enhances immersion and delivers an intense, emotional experience, making the Wither fight feel like a true, epic battle...
